scenes.vo: Prompt Analytics just shipped. Here is what changed in your AI coding, and why.
The dashboard now draws its calendar in 3D, and every section moves in as you scroll.
A level-shift test finds the week things changed. Sessions landing code rose from 32 to 74 percent, since March second.
Cost per landed change gets a watchdog. One week hit 25 dollars, against a usual 3.
Longer opening prompts pay off. At 140 characters or more, 37 percent land code, not 23.
And there is a retry cliff. After three rephrases, only 25 percent of sessions land code.
Even the hour matters. Sessions started in the late morning land code 42 percent of the time, not 22.
Every claim ships with its sample size and confidence interval. AgentKit Prompt Analytics.
